body: Agree sa value, pero biggest trap is eligibility confusion. Hindi porke nagbabayad kayo ng pension ay Category 1 na agad, at hindi rin automatic ang exemption. Before filing, confirm your insured category, child's age on October 1, and same-address condition. If dependent spouse ka under Category 3 or employee under Category 2, ibang rule set ang applicable. Ten minutes of checking beats a rejected filing—or worse, assuming may benefit na hindi pala para sa iyo.
